content:
maria: FYI we just got a dataflow export that contained a service account key in plaintext. looks like a partner ingestion blob. marking high-priority.

vault-bot: Alert: detected potential KMS-unwrapped ciphertext in logs (3 matches) — indexes: logs/ingest/2026-03-21. See /runbooks/sec/ingest-credential-leak for steps.

ashish: copying the log lines now. can someone confirm which SA key id it is? i can run a revoke and issue a scoped key.

kevin: i grabbed the snippet: \"private_key_id\":\"abcd1234-partner\" — appears to be a long-lived json key, not ephemeral.

jordan: if it's partner-managed, we need to coordinate — but prioritize containment first. @kevin can you disable that key in GCP? `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable abcd1234 --iam-account=partner-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

kevin: running disable now. will also add annotation to the key resource for audit.

maria: also check Vault transit unwrap logs — attackers often paste already-unwrapped blobs into partner payloads. `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` if not already enabled.

vault-bot: Notice: vault.audit.log shows 2 unwrap operations from ip 18.33.44.55 at 2026-03-21T09:11Z for key transit/redwood-partner.

ashish: ok, blocking that IP at cloud edge and removing its ingress rules. adding a short-term RBAC rule: remove transit:unwrap from the partner integration role until we reissue keys.

jordan: +1. please make the RBAC change scoped and timeboxed. we don't want to break other tenants. suggested patch: `bindings: - role: roles/vaultTransitUser member: serviceAccount:partner-int@...` -> replace with a scoped role `roles/vaultTransitUser:conditions:...` (we'll put a 1h expiry).

kevin: RBAC change deployed to staging, patch queued for prod with canary on routing=partner. i'll watch for failed jobs.

maria: next steps: 1) revoke the SA key (kevin) 2) issue new short-lived key & rotate partner integration to use KMS-wrapped ephemeral tokens (ashish) 3) scrub logs for other plaintext blobs and mark affected exports (jordan) 4) enable extra audit retention for vault/transit and gcp-iam for 30d.

ashish: i'll prepare a terraform patch to swap the integration to workload identity + ephemeral token flow. will open PR and tag @maria for review.

kevin: SA key disabled. creating new ephemeral credential and emailing partner with rotation window (30m).

jordan: scrubbing logs now with `grep -R \"private_key_id\" /var/log/ingest* | wc -l` then staging an ftps delete for affected export blobs. leaving a forensic snapshot before deletion.

maria: good. please also trigger an audit export to internal sec-bucket and create a ticket in sec-ops with all artifacts. i'll follow up with legal if partner data is impacted.

vault-bot: Action recorded: incident id sec-2026-0311-01 created. recommended checklist: remove long-lived keys, enable ephemeral wrappers, timebox RBAC, preserve forensic snapshots.

ashish: assigning tasks: kevin -> revoke & partner comms; jordan -> log scrub & artifact; ashish -> infra change + PR; maria -> incident owner / legal loop. will check back in 45m. :thumbsup:
